body.estimand_functional: \(c(d+1)^2/[n\log(d+2)]\le R_2(G)\le C d^2/n\) with probability \(1-o(1)\); the upper bound is attained by the published Conflict Graph Design after observed-data Rao--Blackwellization, while the corresponding logarithmic capsule bound remains open.

sampling_model.design: Conditional on the revealed \(G\), the proved upper guarantee uses the outcome-independent published Conflict Graph Design and an observed-data Rao--Blackwellized modified Horvitz--Thompson estimator. The capped balanced reservoir law \(\mathsf D_G^{\mathrm{cap}}\) is retained as a separate candidate whose sharper covariance rate is open.
sampling_model.units: The finite population \(V\) and its potential-outcome schedule are fixed conditional on \(G\); assignment is the only inferential randomness.
sampling_model.treatment: Both designs generate one binary assignment. The published design resolves requested endpoint exposures by a conflict-graph importance ordering; the capsule forces the closed neighborhoods of its two focal reservoirs to opposite arms and randomizes the remainder.
sampling_model.overlap: The published design's desired-exposure probabilities are explicitly positive by its closed-form Lemma 3.3. Uniform order-\(k/n\) overlap for the accepted capsule is part of the unresolved capsule conjecture and is not assumed.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: There are no super-population nuisances. Published desired-exposure weights have closed forms; capsule inclusion and Rao--Blackwell weights are exact finite-design functionals computable by enumeration, while polynomial-time uniform approximation remains open.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: For random \(d\)-regular \(G\) with \(d=o(\sqrt n)\), the published bracket is \(d/n\lesssim R_2(G)\lesssim d^2/n\) with probability \(1-o(1)\).

Lemma 3.3 gives closed-form desired-exposure probabilities, Lemma 4.2 gives the local covariance bounds, and Theorem 4.1 bounds modified Horvitz--Thompson variance by \(12.5\lambda(H_G)/n\) times the two endpoint empirical second moments after the GATE spectral identification.
The neighborhood-union construction gives a one-sided treated-component upper bound under controlled codegrees and leaves the full estimator open.
A greedy independent focal set has size at least \(n\log s/s\) with high probability in the paper's Erd\H{o}s--R\'{e}nyi regime.
Theorem 4 and Corollary 5 compare uniform root mean-squared error of a design-based Riesz estimator with the scaled norm of its variance operator.
The largest balanced independent sets in generic random bipartite graphs have density \((2+o_d(1))\log d/d\), with a factor-two local-algorithm barrier.

body.tldr: For fixed potential outcomes under arbitrary neighborhood interference on a revealed random \(d\)-regular graph, the proved result is a logarithmic-width minimax bracket: with probability \(1-o(1)\), \(c(d+1)^2/[n\log(d+2)]\le R_2(G)\le C d^2/n\). The lower side is the preserved all-procedure theorem; the upper side follows from the published Conflict Graph Design after Rao--Blackwellization into the observed-data minimax class. The reservoir capsule has exact positive-semidefinite, diagonal, block, and constant-mode identities, but its proposed \(O(n/k)\) covariance norm and logarithmically improved risk remain open.

project_justification.gap: Published unrestricted minimax theory places random-regular full-GATE risk between \(d/n\) and \(d^2/n\). The proved all-procedure lower bound raises the lower edge to \((d+1)^2/[n\log(d+2)]\), but no proved design closes the remaining logarithmic factor.
project_justification.niche: The two-copy exposure graph and balanced reservoir capsule expose exact covariance structure that identifies the missing step: a heterogeneous compatible-pair operator bound after acceptance conditioning. This structure is retained as a directed conjecture rather than treated as an attained rate.
project_justification.fill: The paper proves the strengthened all-procedure lower edge, gives a complete observed-data adaptation of the published \(O(d^2/n)\) conflict-graph upper design, derives the capsule's exact finite covariance identities, and states the resulting logarithmic-width bracket without claiming an exact frontier.

body.related_work: Kandiros, Harshaw, and Savje define the identical endpoint-\(L^2\) unrestricted minimax experiment and prove the random-regular bracket \(d/n\lesssim R_2(G)\lesssim d^2/n\) under \(d=o(\sqrt n)\). The preserved all-procedure theorem strengthens their lower edge to order \(d^2/[n\log(d+2)]\) when \(d\to\infty\), but the upper edge remains their order. Kandiros, Pipis, Daskalakis, and Harshaw provide the closed route used here: Lemma 3.3 gives exact desired-exposure probabilities, Lemma 4.2 controls local normalized covariances, and Theorem 4.1 gives the \(O(\lambda(H_G)/n)\) modified Horvitz--Thompson variance bound. Li and Li motivate neighborhood-union denominator protection but prove only a treated-component result. Harshaw, S\"avje, and Wang motivate operator-norm risk analysis, while Perkins and Wang and Cai, Zhang, and Airoldi concern balanced or independent sets in different graph and estimand settings; none supplies the acceptance-conditioned two-arm capsule covariance estimate needed to remove the logarithmic gap.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The unresolved step is uniform control of the accepted reservoir's heterogeneous compatible-pair covariance block. Positive semidefiniteness, diagonal scale, incompatible-pair entries, and fixed-cardinality cancellation are exact, but acceptance conditioning introduces the random denominator \(\binom{|F_G(A)|}{k}\). Entrywise or Schur bounds leave an \(O(d^2)\) contribution, so they cannot prove the desired \(O(n/k)\) norm. No covariance or switching premise is added to assume this crux.
body.honest_scope: The paper proves a strengthened lower edge and a published-design \(O(d^2/n)\) upper edge, not an exact minimax frontier. It does not claim that the capsule attains \(d^2/[n\log d]\), that its focal overlap is uniformly of order \(k/n\), or that a sharpened sample-size threshold has been established. Exact enumeration makes the capsule estimator total but can be exponential; scalable evaluation and certification remain open. No studentized central limit theorem, bounded-outcome model, additive interference model, or real-network random-regular approximation is claimed.
body.interpretation: The result separates what is known from what is suggested by the stable-set capsule. The all-procedure converse rules out risk below order \(d^2/[n\log d]\), whereas the best proved design guarantee is order \(d^2/n\). Exact capsule algebra shows why an \(O(n/k)\) norm would be rate-optimal for that construction, but it does not establish the required upper bound.
